data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2) and the relevant notes in the SoA for Study Period 2 (Section 1.3.2).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1)

data.text: † Baseline/randomization visit detail marker for Visit 2 (Week 0) in SoA Table 1
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1)

data.text: †† Primary endpoint visit detail marker for Visit 6 (Week 12) in SoA Table 1
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1)

data.text: See fasting instructions in Section 8.2.5.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Fasting visit row

data.text: The ICFs must be signed before any protocol-specific tests or procedures are performed. See Section 10.1.3 of the IIBD master protocol for additional details.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Complete informed consent row

data.text: The following confirmations are mandatory: meeting relevant inclusion and exclusion criteria before endoscopy and bowel preparation (Section 8.1.1.3 of the IIBD master protocol), and meeting all inclusion and exclusion criteria before randomization and administration of first dose of study intervention.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Inclusion/exclusion criteria row

data.text: Includes ethnicity (where permissible), year of birth, sex, and race.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Demographics row

data.text: Collect all ongoing conditions and relevant past surgeries and medical history.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Preexisting conditions and medical history row

data.text: Includes all CD-specific therapies since date of diagnosis.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Prior treatments for indication row

data.text: Collect data for all ongoing medications. See Section 6.9 of this ISA and the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Concomitant medications row

data.text: Any events that occur after signing the informed consent are considered AEs as defined in Section 10.3 of the IIBD master protocol. Additional data are collected for certain AEs. For AESIs, see Section 8.3.3 of this ISA and the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Adverse events row

data.text: Collect clinical and laboratory components of CDAI (Section 8.1.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol) and assess participant eligibility at screening before colonoscopy and bowel preparation.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - CDAI row

data.text: *DXA scan must be completed at or within 7 days after V2. If rescan is needed and performed outside the 7 days, this will not be a protocol deviation.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - DXA scan row

data.text: AE collection should occur prior to the collection of the C-SSRS. Adapted for the assessment of ideation and behavior categories only.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - C-SSRS row

data.text: The daily eDiary will be applicable only to Study Period 1 and ED, if ED occurs in Study Period 1. The daily eDiary for CD includes the following assessments (See 8.1.2.4 of the IIBD master protocol): CDAI Stool Frequency, CDAI Abdominal Pain, CDAI General Well-Being, Bowel Movement Count.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Participant daily diary row

data.text: Site personnel must ensure the participant is trained on daily eDiary completion before the endoscopy visits. Provide additional training as needed. For eDiary compliance requirements, see Section 8.1.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Daily eDiary training row

data.text: Site personnel must fully explain and confirm participant understanding of questionnaire before the device is provided to collect response.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Dispense daily eDiary row

data.text: Participant eDiaries are to be completed daily by the participant at home and reviewed by study personnel. See Section 8.1.2.4 of the IIBD master protocol for more details about the eDiary.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Review daily eDiary row

data.text: *At baseline, collect diary from participants who were not eligible for randomization (screen failed).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Return daily eDiary row

data.text: In addition to the fasting visits for lipids testing, site personnel can make fasting recommendations per local guidelines for the procedures.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Laboratory tests and sample collections section header

data.text: At fasting visits. [Lipids (fasting) collected at Visit 2 and Visit 6]
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Lipids (fasting) row

data.text: For IOCBP only (see Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Serum pregnancy row

data.text: For IOCBP, 'negative' test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, urine pregnancy tests will be done on site only. Additional pregnancy tests (urine or serum) should be performed at any time during the study if a menstrual period is missed, or there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation (Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Urine pregnancy (local) row

data.text: *Optional; perform as needed to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals AFAB. See Sections 8.2.6 and 10.4.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) row

data.text: Screening includes HBsAg and anti-HBc. If HBsAg is negative and anti-HBc is positive, further testing for HBV DNA is required (Section 8.2.8 of the IIBD master protocol).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Hepatitis B virus (HBV) screening tests row

data.text: For participants who are anti-HBc positive at screening (Section 8.2.8 of the IIBD master protocol). [HBV DNA at Visit 1 and Visit 5]
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - HBV DNA row

data.text: If HCV Ab test is positive, perform HCV RNA test (Section 8.2.9 of the IIBD master protocol).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Hepatitis C virus (HCV) screening tests row

data.text: Participants who had a TST will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have their test results read. PPD test does not need to be read at the site but must be read by a trained medical professional, and the result must be presented to the site personnel prior to participant's randomization (Section 10.7 of the IIBD master protocol).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Screening and Study Period 1 (SoA Table 1) - Tuberculosis (TB) Test row

data.text: For details about the transition of participants from Study Period 1 to Study Period 2, see the schema (Section 1.2).
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: Participants who received LY/mirikizumab co-administration or mirikizumab in Study Period 1 and who are considered responders at Week 12 of Study Period 1 will receive mirikizumab SC starting at Week 0 of Study Period 2. For definition of responders, see Sections 4.1 and 8.1 of the IIBD master protocol.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: For responders to mirikizumab or LY/mirikizumab co-administration treatment, Visit 6 and Visit 7 will occur on the same day and the Visit 6 procedures are not repeated at Visit 7 (excluding 'Register visit with IWRS').
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: Visit 8 and Visit 10 of the IIBD master protocol SoA do not apply to this ISA.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2)

data.text: † V7 will be conducted on same day as V6

data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2) - Concomitant medications row

data.text: Any events that occur after signing the informed consent are considered AEs as defined in Section 10.3 of the IIBD master protocol. Additional data are collected for certain AEs. See Section 8.3.3 of this ISA and the IIBD master protocol for AESIs.
data.sourceSection: Schedule of Activities for Study Period 2 (SoA Table 2) - Adverse events row

data.text: Perform as shown in this schedule and as needed at any visit based on participant status and standard of care. Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin (Section 8.2.1 of the IIBD master protocol). May be performed by qualified personnel per local regulations. Assess for TB risk factors and for signs and symptoms of active TB, including an assessment of peripheral lymph nodes (Sections 8.2.1 and 8.2.7 of the IIBD master protocol).

data.text: Include pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature (Section 8.2.2 of the IIBD master protocol).
